name: How long does a typical tile or marble installation take to complete?

mainEntity.name: How long does a typical tile or marble installation take to complete?

acceptedAnswer.text: A standard bathroom or kitchen tile installation typically takes between three to seven days depending on the project scope. The timeline begins with surface preparation, including removing old flooring, leveling the subfloor, and installing cement backer board or waterproofing membranes. Setting the tile takes one to two days, followed by a cure time of roughly 24 hours before grout can be applied. After grouting, the surface requires another day to set before caulking, finishing trim, and sealing natural stone. Complex layouts, like herringbone patterns or extensive shower niches, will extend the schedule.
acceptedAnswer.description: Most residential tile projects take three to seven days, including prep work, backer board installation, tile setting, curing, and grouting.
